title: Deadline for Spectrum 27 Is Thursday
content: Tomorrow, Thursday, is the final day for submitting your artwork to Spectrum 27, the annual of contemporary fantastic art. You can submit by uploading your images online, and the fee is reasonable.The jury changes every year, and jurors are always leaders in the field of imaginative art. This year they includeAlice A. Carter,Craig Elliott,Anthony Francisco,Courtney Granner,Forest Rogers,Chie Yoshii-----Here's aquick link to the submissions page.
